curriculum: Illuminate Bible Series, Volume 1: God Our Savior

mappings.verbatimText: The First Five Days of Creation
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. (Genesis 1:1, NKJV)

mappings.element: Day 1 Explorer Story (Sections: Nothing, Poof!, Shaping, Missing pieces)
mappings.verbatimText: Nothing: Have you ever closed your eyes and imagined what it was like before anything was made? ... Poof!: God did not need a hammer, nails, or paint ... Shaping: On Day 2, God made the sky ... Missing pieces: On Day 4, God put the sun to shine by day ...

mappings.element: Day 1 Investigator Narrative (A whole lot of nothing, Nothing to it!, Nothing but good)
mappings.verbatimText: A whole lot of nothing: Have you ever wondered why this world is here? ... Nothing to it!: Human builders need lumber, bricks ... Nothing but good: At each phase of creation, God inspected His work and pronounced it 'good'...
Who created the earth? What is one thing God created in the first five days? Each day, what did God call His work?
How did God create all that exists? What did God call His creation? How do we see God's goodness in creation?
Prayer Point: Praise God for His great power and goodness. Christ Focus: John 1:1-3 teaches that Jesus Christ was there in the beginning and that all things were made through Him.

mappings.element: Day 1 Do This Together / Focal Point Activity
mappings.verbatimText: Explorer: Draw five squares, draw one thing God made in each. Investigator: The Sea in a Jar activity with supply list and steps.
Speed of light fact: Light travels at 186,282 miles per second (299,792 km/s).

mappings.element: Day 2 Investigate: Narrative & First Five Days
mappings.verbatimText: What Happened in the Beginning, God Is Elohim, God Sustains, and the First Five Days Infographic.
Did the snowflakes build this by chance? An intelligent designer is required.
It all starts with God (Thomas Edison light bulb account), Three reasons it matters who made the world, Wonder and worship.

mappings.element: Day 4 Focus: Doctrine - Jesus Was at Creation
mappings.verbatimText: Doctrine: Jesus Was at Creation. One of a kind, Creation and redemption, Orange riddle sidebar, Alpha and Omega sidebar.
All 12 Review questions from the Guide Book covering Days 1-5 of creation.

mappings.element: Day 5 Apply Prompt: Take a Walk Outside
mappings.verbatimText: Take a walk outside prompt: Record three wonders of creation seen, heard, and praise to God.

mappings.element: Day 5 Coloring Page & Clue to Lesson 2
mappings.verbatimText: Color Creation Shore with palette; Clue: 'On day six the Master Artist made His best work. Follow the path into the garden.'
